newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mostly lower, exports boost May.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mostly lower, exports boost May.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mostly lower Thursday but the May contract closed firm on USDA weekly export sales data, traders said.
"Exports were good," a floor source said. "We rallied pretty well but we just ran out of steam. We stayed up for a few hours and didn't get any fund buying so we slipped back down to the day's lows."
USDA today put weekly export sales at 23,200 tonnes, below last week's figure but above trade expectation.
Traders noted several charitable organizations were pushing Japan to donate rice to alleviate food shortages.
Floor sources said U.S. agencies might also choose to buy Vietnamese rice for donation to North Korea but did not expect any large deals soon.
Rice ended eight cents lower to one cent higher, with May up one cent at $11.76 per cwt.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 1,000 lots against Wednesday's actual volume of 368.
